notes.smoke_prompt_tokens: GPT-6.1-Sol smoke rows used ~4510 prompt tokens each vs ~150 for the main models; cost $0.009372/finding is correct for those tokens. Investigation 2026-11-08: the runner sends the same ~150-token prompt to every model, with no Sol-specific content, and Sol rows report ~3801 cached_tokens in every row, about 84 percent of prompt tokens. The extra tokens are therefore provider-side, cached, not sent by the runner. No runner bug was found. Do not assume the same prompt-token count for other models; the safe estimator now uses 4550 prompt tokens for Sol.
